body.p: Claims 1-10 are pending in the present application. In view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks, it is respectfully submitted that all the pending claims are allowable, and reconsideration is respectfully requested.
Applicant notes with appreciation the acknowledgement of the claim for foreign priority and the indication that all copies of the certified copies of the priority documents have been received.

The Office Action objects to claims 5, 6, and 10, rejects claim 3 under 35 U.S.C. § 112 as to definiteness, and rejected claims 1-10 under 35 U.S.C. § 101 as assertedly being directed to non-patentable subject matter. However, the claims have been amended herein without prejudice, thereby obviating these objections and rejections, so that the claims are in condition for immediate allowance. Withdrawal of the objections and rejections is therefore respectfully requested.

Applicant expressly reserves the right to pursue any previously presented claims and supported but as yet unclaimed subject matter in a subsequent patent application claiming the benefit of priority of the present application. Further, nothing in the prosecution of the present application should be construed as a concession or an intent to concede any issue with regard to any claim, except as specifically stated, and the amendment of any claim during prosecution of the present application does not signify concession of unpatentability of the claim prior to the amendment of the claim. Additionally, Applicant makes no admissions that any of the cited references or any other reference of record constitutes prior art or is relevant to any of the claims of the present application or any subsequent patent application claiming the benefit of priority of the present application.

Additionally, a disclaimer of claim scope made during prosecution can be rescinded permitting recapture of the disclaimed scope, where the prosecution history is sufficiently clear to inform the examiner that the previous disclaimer, and the prior art that it was made to avoid, may need to be re-visited. See Hakim v. Cannon Avent Group, PLC, et al., Fed. Cir. 05-1398 (2007). To the extent that any amendments or arguments made in the present application can be interpreted as a disclaimer of subject matter, Applicant no longer intends to be limited to the elements added to the claims or the arguments made in order to expedite prosecution, hereby expressly rescinds

any such disclaimer, and respectfully submits that any such disclaimer is not to be read into or against any other pending or related application; and any disclaimer that may have occurred during the prosecution of the present application is hereby expressly rescinded as regards any subsequently filed continuation application.

In view of the foregoing, it is respectfully submitted that all of the presently pending claims are in condition for allowance. All issues raised having been addressed, it is therefore respectfully requested that the objections and rejections be withdrawn, and prompt reconsideration and allowance of the present application are therefore earnestly solicited. Additionally, Applicant does not acquiesce to the Office's characterizations of the claim language or of any cited reference, and reserves the right to challenge any such characterizations in the future. The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at the telephone number listed below if such a call would in any way facilitate allowance of this application.
